input.quote: Customer may terminate this Agreement or any Order Form without cause by delivering the written notice specified in Section 29.4. Customer owes only accrued Fees, and Vendor shall refund prepaid Fees for the period after termination.
input.rationale: We have a convenience right on 30 days' notice (9.4 read with 29.4) with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees and no early-termination fee, and Section 9 gives Vendor no convenience right (only material breach and insolvency). This matches our preferred position.

input.quote: thereafter renews for successive twelve-month periods unless Customer gives Vendor at least thirty days' written notice of non-renewal. Vendor shall remind Customer of an upcoming renewal at least sixty days beforehand.
input.rationale: Automatic 12-month renewals with a 30-day Customer opt-out, a 60-day Vendor reminder (with deadline extension if missed), and renewal uplift capped at the lesser of CPI and 3% on 90 days' notice — exactly our preferred position.
